2610.10388.title: RoboQuest: Generalist Physical Agents that Search, Inspect and Test
2610.10388.paper_summary: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have made them capable generalist physical agents for a range of manipulation tasks. However, successful operation in an unfamiliar environment may require an agent to seek task-relevant information through interaction when it is absent from the observations: it may need to determine where a relevant object is, inspect an unobserved property, or discover the effect of an unfamiliar tool. We thus introduce RoboQuest, a benchmark for goal-directed embodied exploration, where agents must actively acquire task-relevant information through physical interaction, use the resulting evidence to adapt subsequent actions, and autonomously decide when to commit to task completion. RoboQuest comprises ten mobile manipulation tasks centered on three forms of uncertainty: search, manipulation-based inspection, and interactive testing. We evaluate five frontier multimodal agents through a common visuomotor interface, as well as a $π_{0.5}$ policy fine-tuned on the full-episode demonstrations we release. The best agent succeeds in only 23\% of the episodes, and the fine-tuned policy almost never succeeds. Isolated tests of the execution skills the tasks are built from, with the hidden information supplied, show that the agents can carry out most of the required actions, and our failure analysis attributes only a minority of the failures to execution. Our failure analysis further finds that the agents often stop exploring too early as they make decisions before observing the required evidence for task completion. We also find that agents rarely prevent or repair the disturbances caused by their exploration. Moreover, learning by trial and error remains difficult for most models.
2610.10388.paper_summary_zh: 最近在多模態基礎模型方面的進展使它們能夠成為一系列操作任務的通用物理代理。<lb/>然而，在不熟悉的環境中成功運作可能需要代理通過互動尋求與任務相關的信息，當這些信息在觀察中缺失時：它可能需要確定相關物體的位置，檢查未觀察到的屬性，或發現不熟悉工具的效果。<lb/>因此，我們介紹了RoboQuest，一個以目標為導向的具身探索基準，代理必須通過物理互動主動獲取與任務相關的信息，利用所獲得的證據來調整後續行動，並自主決定何時承諾完成任務。<lb/>RoboQuest包含十個以移動操控為中心的任務，圍繞三種不確定性形式：搜索、基於操控的檢查和互動測試。<lb/>我們通過一個共同的視覺運動接口評估五個前沿多模態代理，以及一個在我們釋放的完整回合演示上微調的$π_{0.5}$策略。<lb/>最佳代理在僅23\%的回合中成功，而微調的策略幾乎從未成功。<lb/>對執行技能的孤立測試顯示，代理可以執行大多數所需的行動，而我們的失敗分析僅將少數失敗歸因於執行。<lb/>我們的失敗分析進一步發現，代理經常在觀察到完成任務所需的證據之前過早停止探索。<lb/>我們還發現，代理很少防止或修復其探索所造成的干擾。此外，對大多數模型來說，通過試錯學習仍然困難。
